#Anon, Just Wants To Hold A Boy's Hand (Or Any Boy's Hand, Really)

I just wanna hold this boy's hand. I mean, even if it wasn't HIM, I just wanna hold a boy's hand at the hall and be lined up against the fuppin' walls of public rejection and being ostracized for being who I am.

WHY does anyone care? WHY do they hate us for LOVING?! That's so ironic, you f*cking normies. Feels weird to hear people casually insulting us as if we didn't exist.

Any chance of social life I had before would be OBLITERATED by coming out of this cage. 

I like to be a cute girly boy, what's WRONG with it?! REEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE! I just want to feel love, /b/. Is that too much to ask?! Is it?! TELL ME!!!
